dossier.summary: Bramblewood Foods makes frozen bakery products for grocery chains from two plants in Illinois. About 300 people. A finance team of six invoices 40 retail customers and pays bills from about 250 ingredient and packaging suppliers.
dossier.why_now: Posted an opening for a senior accountant with month-end close in the description last month.

data.title: Close the books in five days
data.tagline: A hands-on afternoon for finance teams. You map your own month-end close, pick the three steps that cost the most days, and leave with a plan to fix them.
data.audience: Controllers, finance managers and the people who run month-end at companies with 50 to 500 people.

agenda.title: Where the days go
agenda.note: What a five-day close looks like, and the four places most teams lose a week.

agenda.title: Map your own close
agenda.note: On paper, step by step: who does what, on which day, and what each step waits on.

agenda.title: Pick the three steps to fix first
agenda.note: Score each step by days lost and effort to change. Pair up and challenge each other's picks.

agenda.title: Write the 90-day plan
agenda.note: One page: the three steps, who owns each, and what changes in month one, two and three.

agenda.title: Read-outs and what we send you after

bring: Your current close checklist or calendar, in whatever form it exists
The dates your last three closes finished
A laptop, for the templates we share in the room
The one step of the close that frustrates you most
data.host_note: Noor Haddad runs the session and reads every plan written in the room. The group stays at twelve on purpose, so there is time to go through each one.
data.confirm_note: Your seat is confirmed by email within a day, with a short pre-read and directions to The Loft.
data.why_now: Posted an opening for a senior accountant with month-end close in the description last month.
data.why_you: Bramblewood closes two plants and pays about 250 suppliers with a finance team of six, and you are hiring a senior accountant for month-end. The afternoon is about the close that person inherits.

leave_with.lead: A close calendar for a six-person finance team
leave_with.text: Every step of Bramblewood's month-end on one page, split between the two plants and head office, with the day each step happens and what it waits on.

leave_with.lead: The three steps to fix first
leave_with.text: Scored by days lost and effort to change. With bills from about 250 suppliers, invoice matching will be on the list, but the room decides from your own map.

leave_with.lead: A one-page 90-day plan for your CFO
leave_with.text: What changes in month one, two and three, written so the senior accountant you are hiring can pick it up on day one.
